intended_application: acid–base-sensitive active and/or smart packaging, proposed as food freshness sensors

process_steps.description: Deionised water added to dried hibiscus flowers in an ultrasound bath

source.quote: 50 g of deionised water was added to 10 g of dried hibiscus flowers, and the mixture was placed in an ultrasound bath (Sonic 10, Polsonic, Warsaw, Poland) for 10 min at 40 °C

process_steps.description: Extract filtered, olive oil added, and emulsified with a 20 kHz ultrasonic processor

source.quote: After filtration, 50 g of oil was added to the filtrate, and emulsification was performed using a 20 kHz low-frequency ultrasonic processor (Sonopuls HD 4200, Bandelin, Berlin, Germany) for 5 min
A suspension of 40.0 g of sodium alginate in 940 g of water was prepared

process_steps.description: Stirred at 700 rpm until a homogeneous gel formed

source.quote: The resulting suspension was stirred with a magnetic stirrer (Heidolph RZR 2020, Heidolph Instruments GmbH & Co. KG, Schwabach, Deutschland) at 70 °C, 700 RPM, until a homogeneous gel was obtained
Then, 20 g of glycerine was added as a plasticiser

process_steps.description: Chitosan mixture stirred at 700 rpm until a clear gel formed

source.quote: The mixture was placed on a magnetic stirrer (700 rpm, temperature: 70 °C; Heidolph RZR 2020, Heidolph Instruments GmbH & Co. KG, Schwabach, Deutschland) until a clear gel was obtained

process_steps.description: Emulsion 1 added to the chitosan hydrogel and homogenised until uniform

source.quote: 5.0 g of emulsion 1 was added to a 150 g 2% chitosan hydrogel and mixed with a mechanical homogeniser (Polytron PT 2500 E, Kinematica AG, Malters, Switzerland) until a uniform mixture was produced

process_steps.description: Chitosan mixture added to the sodium alginate suspension while homogenising

source.quote: the resulting hydrogel was added to a 300 g 2% sodium alginate suspension while stirring with the mechanical homogeniser for a further 15 min

process_steps.description: Poured into a 250 × 200 mm polypropylene tray

source.quote: The resulting hydrogel was poured into a 250 × 200 mm polypropylene tray and dried at room temperature (25 ± 2 °C) for 48 h
The resulting hydrogel was poured into a 250 × 200 mm polypropylene tray and dried at room temperature (25 ± 2 °C) for 48 h
